name: DY DEOKYANG Co.,Ltd.
summary: DY DEOKYANG Co.,Ltd. operates as a manufacturer and supplier of automotive components within South Korea. Its product line encompasses a wide array of vehicle parts, including internal fixtures like cockpit module sub-assemblies, instrument panel parts, door trims, and consoles, as well as exterior elements and carriers. Additionally, the company develops and supplies advanced battery module assemblies and comprehensive energy storage systems. Established in 1977, the firm maintains its principal office in Ulsan, South Korea.
